name: race-coach-overlay
description: Smart overlay and racing coach for Assetto Corsa.

scripts.zip: mkdir -p apps/lua/race-coach-overlay && cp -r lua-app/* apps/lua/race-coach-overlay/ && mkdir -p apps/lua/race-coach-overlay/overlay && cp overlay/index.html overlay/style.css overlay/app.js apps/lua/race-coach-overlay/overlay/ && python3 -m zipfile -c race-coach-overlay.zip apps/ && rm -rf apps/
